# Josie Pye

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Autumn P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)</sub>
- **Family:** [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) (cousin), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Josie Pye wears dresses featuring flounces, which are considered particularly stylish for the fall season.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is known for her disagreeable, sharp-tongued, and outspoken nature, alongside a notable lack of imagination and a scornful attitude. Inherently skilled at walking board fences, she has also demonstrated talent in knitting lace, taking a first prize for her work. Financially secure enough that she does not need to earn her own living, she attends college purely for the sake of education.

## History

Josie Pye cultivated a natural talent for walking board fences. During a party, she challenged [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of a kitchen roof, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fall and break her ankle. Later, while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Josie visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and Ruby to share news about the Avery scholarship and to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Quotes

> "Queen’s is to get one of the Avery scholarships after all. The word came today. Frank Stockley told me—his uncle is one of the board of governors, you know. It will be announced in the Academy tomorrow."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)

> "If I don’t pass this year I’m coming back next. My father can afford to send me. Anne, Frank Stockley says that Professor Tremaine said Gilbert Blythe was sure to get the medal and that Emily Clay would likely win the Avery scholarship."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)

> "I dare you to climb up there and walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry’s kitchen roof."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)

> "I don’t believe anybody could walk a ridgepole. You couldn’t, anyhow."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)

> "Your new dress is rather becoming to you, Anne. Really, you look almost pretty in it."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v3 ch.Autumn P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)

## Relationships

### [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--josie-pye.md)

Josie and [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) are sisters and members of the [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes) family. Both were present among the students during Mr. Phillips's tenure at school, as well as during later local village events like the A.V.I.S. farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P71](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0071), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), +7 more_
